newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mercedes chief Werner to step down - report.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes chief Werner to step down - report.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz AG Chairman Helmut Werner will leave the Daimler-Benz AG group as part of a restructuring, the daily Stuttgarter Zeitung said.

The newspaper will report in its Friday edition that Werner and Daimler have agreed to disolve his contract that was to run through 1999. It also said that Werner would not take a post within the reorganised Daimler group.
The newspaper provided a copy of the article in advance of its publication.
The Daimler presidium group was to meet on Thursday to discuss the restructuring. A Daimler spokesman declined to comment on the article.
